name: The Great Akazamzarak
guide_text: This hero is best to copy [[Eternal Knight||95261]] or Fresh Perspective dark gift if you see it early on. Taunt it and choose Pack Tactic's secret. Otherwise, choose Venomstrike Trap.
buddy_guide_text: Golden buddy allows you to pick double secret, it's quite strong. This buddy is also very strong with poison scam if the lobby isn't playing Mechs, Beasts, or Undead.
